_comment: Paul Mitchell Shines XG (Demi-Permanent) technical specifications
_source: Paul Mitchell Shines XG reference sheet

developers.notes: Use for depositing color on previously colored or porous hair. Minimal lift.
Use for blending gray, refreshing color, or subtle lift.

grayBlending.notes: Use NN series for resistant gray coverage. Mix NN shade with desired fashion tone for gray coverage with tonal refinement.

clearShade.use: Dilute or deposit tone without changing level
clearShade.notes: Use Clear to create sheer color results or soften intensity.

fashionShadeTips: Mix with NN series for gray coverage with fashion tone
Use 10 Volume for fashion shades on virgin hair
Use 5 Volume for refreshing or depositing on previously colored hair
